introduction.en_us:
# GamesAI for MCDReforged English | [简体中文](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main//README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main//README.zh-TW.md) [Report an Issue](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/issues/new) | [Share an Idea](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/discussions/new/choose) | [Join QQ Group](https://qm.qq.com/q/jDQQaUPNmw) [Go to Fabric Version](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/GamesAI)
> [!NOTE] > **GamesAI Plugin/Mod QQ Group: 849544707** — Join us to discuss issues, share feedback, and exchange prompt, skills, tools configurations! > [!NOTE] > Welcome to version 0.7.3! This release reworks the **message layout of a request**: there is only one system message now (the model's prompt + the skills list), the current time travels as a `user` message in front of the question and is re-injected periodically, the public data travels as an `assistant` message, and adjacent `user` messages are merged into one before sending — so models that accept a single leading system message only (Qwen3.5 and friends) work again, and the provider's prefix cache keeps hitting in long conversations. See [What's New](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/changelog.md#whats-new) for details.
Table of Contents (click to expand) - [GamesAI for MCDReforged](#gamesai-for-mcdreforged) - [Installation](#installation) - [Usage](#usage) - [Technical Documentation](#technical-documentation) - [The Role of AI in This Project](#the-role-of-ai-in-this-project) - [Acknowledgements \& Disclaimer](#acknowledgements--disclaimer) - [Sponsorship \& Contributors](#sponsorship--contributors) - [License](#license)
## Installation Run the following command in the MCDR console to install the plugin: `!!MCDR plugin install games_ai` --- Alternatively, get it from the [MCDR Plugin Repository](https://mcdreforged.com/plugin/games_ai) and place it in your plugin directory. If you choose to install manually, install the Python packages `openai`, `requests`, and `websockets` first: ```bash pip install openai requests websockets ``` ## Usage Type `!!gamesai` anywhere to display all available features of this plugin. | Command | Description | | ------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `!!gamesai clear` | Clear your own chat history. Chat history is unrelated to the public database. | | `!!gamesai clearall` | Clear all players' chat history. Chat history is unrelated to the public database. | | `!!gamesai reload` | Reload the plugin configuration file. See [Hot Reload](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/hot-reload.md#hot-reload) for details. | | `!!gamesai check` | Check for plugin updates and force-refresh the context-window table. | | `!!gamesai speedtest [model]` | Test API server connection latency. If no model is specified, all models are tested. | | `!!gamesai config get ` | Read a configuration value. | | `!!gamesai config set ` | Update a configuration value (auto type-adapts; automatically triggers [Hot Reload](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/hot-reload.md#hot-reload)). | --- You can also use `!!ask` directly to ask the AI questions, chat, or ask it to do things for you. | Command | Description | | ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `!!ask ` | Ask the AI a question, chat, or ask it to do something. `` is what you want the AI to do or the question you want to ask. | | `!!ask -n ` | Ask the AI without using conversation history (current conversation is still saved). | | `!!ask -f ` | Force-ask without waiting: the request is merged into the round that is currently running (alias: `-forced`). See [AI Request Pipeline & Chat Mechanism](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#ai-request-pipeline--chat-mechanism). | | `!!ask switch ` | Switch the AI model for your current conversation (`` is the AI_ID or nickname). The history is cleared and the old model summarizes it right before your next request, handing the summary to the new model. See [Summary Hand-off on Model Switch](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#summary-hand-off-on-model-switch). | | `!!ask stop` | Immediately stop everything you have in flight: your running round (tool calls included), a running `!!ask -n` request and a task you delegated to the bot. The interrupted step is deleted from the history and queued `!!ask -f` messages are discarded. See [Stopping a running round](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#stopping-a-running-round). | | `!!ask context [player]` | Show the context usage: model and window source, how much of the window is used, how many tokens are left before compression, the per-round sizes and the cache-hit rate. Without a player name it shows your own. See [Context Inspection](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#context-inspection). | | `!!ask context --all` | Sum the context usage of every player on the server, grouped by model (models with zero usage are not listed); hover for the totals since the plugin was loaded. See [Context Inspection](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#context-inspection). | | `!!ask compact` | Compress the older history right now, ignoring the compression triggers. It is performed by the preflight of your next question, so the command itself never blocks. See [Context Inspection](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#context-inspection). | --- Type `!!data` for information about database commands. > [!TIP] > The database is automatically created when upgrading to version 0.3.0 or above. | Command | Description | | ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | `!!data write ` | Add a data entry to the public database. `` must not contain spaces; `` can be any string. | | `!!data add ` | Append `` to an existing key in the public database. Creates a new key if it does not exist. | | `!!data del ` | Delete a data entry from the public database, regardless of whether the key exists. | | `!!data read ` | Read the value associated with a key from the public database. | | `!!data list` | Read all entries in the public database. | | `!!data list keys` | Read all keys in the public database. | --- ## Technical Documentation The technical details live in [`docs/en_us/`](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/) — how a request is built and kept inside the window, what every configuration key does, how tools and skills work, how the bot is driven, and what to do when something fails. | Document | Contents | | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | Pipeline](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md) | Request chain, the stateless `!!ask -n`, the `!!ask switch` hand-off, `!!ask stop`, automatic context management, per-user state | | [Configuration](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/configuration.md) | Every key of `config.json`: `prefix`, `permission`, `all_ai` (incl. `context_window`), `default_ai`, `mineflayer_bot` | | [Tools](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/tools.md) | The 26 built-in tools, writing your own in `tools.py`, registering tools from your own plugin, permissions and visibility | | [Skills](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/skills.md) | What skills are for, the built-in ones, `skills.json`, letting the AI write them, registering them from your own plugin | | [Example](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/example.md) | A real server configuration end to end: config, six skills, 44 custom tools, a walkthrough round and the pitfalls | | [Mineflayer Bot](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/mineflayer-bot.md) | happens during one, following it from your plugin | | [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/troubleshooting.md) | `!!ask` errors, bot errors, logging & releases.description:
## GamesAI 0.7.3

本次更新重做了**请求里的消息结构**：不再出现第二条 system 消息，时间改由提问前的 `user` 消息承载，长会话的前缀缓存也能持续命中。

### 🧱 消息结构重做

- **system 只剩一条** — prompt 与技能列表合并为一条 system 消息，当前时间从中移出。部分上游（Qwen3.5/3.6/3.8 的 chat template 等）只允许下标 0 是 system，此前会直接返回 `System message must be at the beginning`，这些模型完全不可用。
- **公共数据改用 `assistant`** — 它是资料而不是命令；公共数据库为空时这条消息完全不发送，不会再出现一条空的"公共数据列表:"。
- **当前时间改为 `user` 消息，写在提问正前方** — 第 1 轮注入，之后每 20 轮再注入一次。它写入历史，因此相邻两轮之间的提示词前缀完全一致，服务商的前缀缓存可以持续命中（此前时间在 system 首行、每轮都变，等于每轮把整段历史重新计费一次）。
- **技能提示改用 `user`** — `!!ask /技能.md` 注入的"先读这个技能"提示不再是一条 system。
- **连续的 `user` 消息在发出前合并成一条** — 时间 + 提问、技能提示 + 提问、`!!ask -f` 的多条补充、上一轮失败后的重问都会合并：部分上游要求 user/assistant 严格交替，模型也不会再把它们当成两轮、只答最后一条。历史里仍分别保存。
- **轮次切分同步修正** — 连续 `user` 视为同一回合，注入的时间不会被算成独立一轮（`KEEP_ROUNDS = 10` 与压缩边界保持正确）。

### 🔧 修复

- **清理残留 Node 进程的两处调用** — `run_node()`（启动前清理）与"检测到不支持的服务器版本 → 重装依赖并重启假人"路径上的 `_kill_mineflayer_process()` 都补上了缺失的进程参数；此前会抛 `TypeError` 并被 `try/except` 吞掉，只留下一条日志。
- **调试日志字段更名** — `!!gamesai debug` 的请求头部由 `system=` 改为 `preamble=`（该位置现在也可能包含一条 assistant 消息）。

### 📚 文档

- 三语技术文档新增「请求里的消息结构」一节，并同步更新请求链路、`!!ask -n` 一致性条目与"每玩家状态"里的 `system_message` 说明。

### ⚠️ 已知问题

- 历史压缩摘要与切模型转接摘要仍以 `system` 消息注入（本次未改动），因此在只允许一条 system 的上游上，这两条路径仍可能被拒绝。

### 升级提示

- **配置无需改动**；`!!ask -n` 与常规路径的消息结构保持一致。
- 升级后第一次请求会重建提示词前缀，旧的前缀缓存会失效一次，之后恢复正常。

完整说明见 [`docs/zh_cn/changelog.md`](docs/zh_cn/changelog.md)。

---

## GamesAI 0.7.3

This release reworks the **message layout of a request**: a second system message is gone, the current time travels as a `user` message in front of the question, and the provider's prefix cache keeps hitting in long conversations.

### 🧱 The message layout

- **A single system message** — the model's prompt and the skills list are merged into one system message, with the current time moved out of it. Some upstreams (the Qwen3.5/3.6/3.8 chat template, for one) accept a system message at index 0 only and answered `System message must be at the beginning`, which made those models unusable.
- **The public data travels as an `assistant` message** — reference material rather than an instruction; when the database is empty the message is not sent at all, so the empty "public data" line is gone.
- **The current time travels as a `user` message right in front of the question** — injected on the first round, then once every 20 rounds. It is stored in the history, so two consecutive rounds share exactly the same prefix and the provider's prefix cache keeps hitting (before, the time sat in the first line of the system block and changed every round, re-billing the whole history every round).
- **The skill note changed role** — the "read this skill first" note injected by `!!ask /skill.md` is a `user` message now, not a `system` one.
- **Adjacent `user` messages are merged into one before sending** — time + question, the skill note + question, several `!!ask -f` messages, a question retried after a failed round. Some upstreams require strict user/assistant alternation, and a model reading two user turns in a row tends to answer only the last one. The history keeps them apart.
- **Round splitting fixed along with it** — consecutive `user` messages count as one round, so an injected time never becomes a round of its own (`KEEP_ROUNDS = 10` and the compression boundaries stay correct).

### 🔧 Fixes

- **Both `_kill_mineflayer_process()` call sites** — the one in `run_node()` (cleanup before starting) and the one on the "unsupported server version → reinstall dependencies and restart the bot" path now pass the process argument; they used to raise `TypeError`, which the surrounding `try/except` swallowed into a single log line.
- **Debug log field renamed** — the request header printed by `!!gamesai debug` is `preamble=` now instead of `system=` (that position can also hold an `assistant` message).

### 📚 Documentation

- A new "What a request contains" section in all three languages, plus matching updates to the request chain, the `!!ask -n` consistency list and the `system_message` entry under per-user state.

### ⚠️ Known issues

- Context-compression summaries and model-switch hand-off summaries are still injected as `system` messages (unchanged in this release), so on upstreams that accept a single system message those two paths can still be rejected.

### Upgrade notes

- **No configuration change is required**; the stateless path (`!!ask -n`) uses the same layout as the normal one.
- The first request after the upgrade rebuilds the prompt prefix, so the old prefix cache misses once and then works normally.

Full details: [`docs/en_us/changelog.md`](docs/en_us/changelog.md).

---

## GamesAI 0.7.3

本次更新重做了**請求裡的訊息結構**：不再出現第二條 system 訊息，時間改由提問前的 `user` 訊息承載，長對話的前綴快取也能持續命中。

### 🧱 訊息結構重做

- **system 只剩一條** —— prompt 與技能列表合併為一條 system 訊息，目前時間從中移出。部分上游（Qwen3.5/3.6/3.8 的 chat template 等）只允許下標 0 是 system，此前會直接回傳 `System message must be at the beginning`，這些模型完全不可用。
- **公共資料改用 `assistant`** —— 它是資料而不是命令；公共資料庫為空時這條訊息完全不發送，不會再出現一條空的「公共資料列表:」。
- **目前時間改為 `user` 訊息，寫在提問正前方** —— 第 1 輪注入，之後每 20 輪再注入一次。它會寫入歷史，因此相鄰兩輪之間的提示詞前綴完全一致，服務商的前綴快取可以持續命中（此前時間在 system 首行、每輪都變，等於每輪把整段歷史重新計費一次）。
- **技能提示改用 `user`** —— `!!ask /技能.md` 注入的「先讀這個技能」提示不再是一條 system。
- **連續的 `user` 訊息在送出前合併成一條** —— 時間 + 提問、技能提示 + 提問、`!!ask -f` 的多條補充、上一輪失敗後的重問都會合併：部分上游要求 user/assistant 嚴格交替，模型也不會再把它們當成兩輪、只答最後一條。歷史裡仍分別保存。
- **輪次切分同步修正** —— 連續 `user` 視為同一回合，注入的時間不會被算成獨立一輪（`KEEP_ROUNDS = 10` 與壓縮邊界保持正確）。

### 🔧 修復

- **清理殘留 Node 行程的兩處呼叫** —— `run_node()`（啟動前清理）與「偵測到不支援的伺服器版本 → 重裝依賴並重啟假人」路徑上的 `_kill_mineflayer_process()` 都補上了缺失的行程參數；此前會拋 `TypeError` 並被 `try/except` 吞掉，只留下一條日誌。
- **除錯日誌欄位更名** —— `!!gamesai debug` 的請求頭部由 `system=` 改為 `preamble=`（該位置現在也可能包含一條 assistant 訊息）。

### 📚 文件

- 三語技術文件新增「請求裡的訊息結構」一節，並同步更新請求鏈路、`!!ask -n` 一致性條目與「每玩家狀態」裡的 `system_message` 說明。

### ⚠️ 已知問題

- 歷史壓縮摘要與切換模型轉接摘要仍以 `system` 訊息注入（本次未改動），因此在只允許一條 system 的上游上，這兩條路徑仍可能被拒絕。

### 升級提示

- **設定無需改動**；`!!ask -n` 與一般路徑的訊息結構保持一致。
- 升級後第一次請求會重建提示詞前綴，舊的前綴快取會失效一次，之後恢復正常。

完整說明見 [`docs/zh_tw/changelog.md`](docs/zh_tw/changelog.md)。

releases.description:
## GamesAI 0.7.2

本次更新把上下文管理从"看不见"变成"看得见"，并修掉了三个真实缺陷。

### 🔍 上下文查看：三条只读指令

- **`!!ask context [玩家]`** — 窗口多大、来源是哪一层（配置覆盖 / 模型表 / 默认值）、上下文占了多少、距离压缩还有多少余量、逐轮规模与缓存命中率。不填玩家即查看自己。悬停可看三条触发线的具体数值、逐轮 token、上次请求用量与最近一次压缩。
- **`!!ask context --all`** — 按模型汇总全服用量，零用量的模型不列出；悬停显示**自插件加载以来**的累计消耗与缓存命中率（0.1% 精度）。累计值不会因压缩而减少。
- **`!!ask compact`** — 忽略触发线，立即压缩较早的历史；延迟到下次提问的预检执行，指令本身不阻塞。

### 🔧 修复

- **`!!ask stop it.` 不再被丢弃** — 以前 `stop` 是独立命令节点，带多余文字会被 MCDR 判为未知参数并**整条不执行**；`!!ask switch it.` 则把 `it.` 当模型名。现在 `!!ask` 由命令分发器解析，只有**恰好是那个词**才当子指令，任何句子都会落到 AI。顺带修好 `!!ask -n`（缺内容）与 `!!ask contextual` 被前缀吞掉的问题。
- **两次 `!!gamesai reload` 并发会把假人功能关掉** — 后者的端口探测把前者未退出的 Node 当成外来程序，进而把 `mineflayer_bot.enabled` 写成 `false`。现在重载单飞（重入直接拒绝），端口探测会先等待停机完成。
- **`mineflayer_bot.enabled` 被误关闭** — 写 `config.json` 前先确保目录存在；`stop_mineflayer_bot` 补上缺失的 `@register_bot_tool()`。

### 🧹 卸载与停机不再被假人拖住

- Node 停机从"逐级升级、最多串行等 21 秒"改为一次终止 + 有限等待，**实测 5 毫秒**；
- 卸载把停机搬到独立后台线程，`on_unload` 只同步等 1.5 秒；该线程只用纯 Python 对象，不碰 MCDR 状态；
- 首次连接退避（新配置项 `first_connect_interval`，默认 0.5 秒），不再因为 Node 还在启动就白等 10 秒。

### 🧵 线程可观测

- 新增 **`!!gamesai debug thread`**：列出插件持有的线程（id、名称、daemon、`native=`）；
- 全部线程统一命名 `games_ai@...`；卸载后残留的旧控制器线程会在下次加载时被中止，而不是与新实例并存。

### 📚 文档重写与新增

- 原「工具与 Skills」一页**拆分为独立的[工具](docs/zh_cn/tools.md)与[技能](docs/zh_cn/skills.md)**，并按当前实现重写：补齐**权限**与 **Bot 可见性**两列、修正与代码不符的参数说明（如 `delegate_to_bot` 的 `username`、`bot_call_action` 的可选参数）、说明 `tools.py` 中无装饰器的公开函数会被拒绝加载；
- 新增**[范例](docs/zh_cn/example.md)**：一台真实服务器从配置、六个技能、44 个自定义工具到一轮实操的完整实例，含踩坑表与取舍分析；
- 技术文档现为**九个**页面，随插件一起打包。

### 升级提示

- 版本号由 `0.7.2-SNAPSHOT-4` 定为 **`0.7.2`**；旧配置里的历史长度键（如 `max_history`）会被忽略，无需改动。
- 新增可选配置 `mineflayer_bot.websocket.first_connect_interval`（默认 0.5），不填也会按此默认值工作。

完整说明见 [`docs/zh_cn/changelog.md`](docs/zh_cn/changelog.md)。

---

## GamesAI 0.7.2

This release makes context management visible instead of invisible, and fixes three real defects.

### 🔍 Context Inspection: three read-only commands

- **`!!ask context [player]`** — the window size, which layer it comes from (config override / model table / default), how much context is in use, how many tokens are left before compression, the per-round sizes and the cache hit rate. Without a player name it shows your own. The hover adds the exact trigger lines, the per-round tokens, the last request's usage and the last compression.
- **`!!ask context --all`** — the whole server summed up per model, with models that have zero usage left out; the hover shows the totals **since the plugin was loaded** plus the cache hit rate (0.1% resolution). Those totals never shrink when a history is compressed.
- **`!!ask compact`** — compress the older history now, ignoring the triggers; it is deferred to the preflight of your next question, so the command itself never blocks.

### 🔧 Fixes

- **`!!ask stop it.` is no longer dropped** — `stop` used to be its own command node, so extra text made MCDR reject the whole line as an unknown argument and **execute nothing**; `!!ask switch it.` instead took `it.` as a model name. `!!ask` is now parsed by a command dispatcher where only **exactly that word** acts as a subcommand, so any sentence reaches the model. A bare `!!ask -n` and words like `!!ask contextual` are fixed along the way.
- **Two concurrent `!!gamesai reload` used to switch the bot off** — the second one's port probe saw the first one's dying Node process as a foreign program and wrote `mineflayer_bot.enabled = false`. Reloads are now single-flight (a re-entry is rejected), and the port probe waits for a running teardown first.
- **`mineflayer_bot.enabled` switched off by mistake** — the directory is created before `config.json` is written, and `stop_mineflayer_bot` got its missing `@register_bot_tool()`.

### 🧹 Unload and shutdown no longer held hostage by the bot

- Node shutdown went from an escalating ladder that could wait up to 21 s in series to one terminate plus a bounded wait — **measured at 5 ms**;
- the unload hands the slow half to a detached background thread and waits 1.5 s synchronously; that thread only touches plain Python objects, never MCDR state;
- first-connect backoff (new option `first_connect_interval`, default 0.5 s) instead of sleeping 10 s merely because Node is still booting.

### 🧵 Threads are observable

- New **`!!gamesai debug thread`**: lists the threads the plugin holds (id, name, daemon flag, `native=`);
- every thread is named `games_ai@...`; a controller thread that survived an unload is aborted on the next load instead of running next to the new instance.

### 📚 Documentation rewritten and extended

- The former "Tools & Skills" page was **split into separate [Tools](docs/en_us/tools.md) and [Skills](docs/en_us/skills.md) pages** and rewritten against the current implementation: a **permission** and a **bot-visibility** column were added, parameter descriptions that did not match the code were corrected (`delegate_to_bot`'s `username`, `bot_call_action`'s optional `params`), and the loader's behaviour of rejecting undecorated public functions in `tools.py` is now documented;
- a new **[Example](docs/en_us/example.md)** page walks through a real server end to end: its configuration, six skills, 44 custom tools, one actual round of use, and the pitfalls;
- the technical documentation is now **nine** pages and ships inside the plugin archive.

### Upgrade notes

- The version is **`0.7.2`** (was `0.7.2-SNAPSHOT-4`); a history-length key left over from an older config (such as `max_history`) is ignored, so no config change is required.
- New optional option `mineflayer_bot.websocket.first_connect_interval` (default 0.5); leaving it out uses that default.

Full details: [`docs/en_us/changelog.md`](docs/en_us/changelog.md).

---

## GamesAI 0.7.2

本次更新把上下文管理從「看不見」變成「看得見」，並修掉三個真實缺陷。

### 🔍 上下文檢視：三條唯讀指令

- **`!!ask context [玩家]`** — 視窗多大、來源是哪一層（設定覆寫 / 模型表 / 預設值）、上下文佔了多少、距離壓縮還剩多少餘量、逐輪規模與快取命中率。不填玩家即查看自己。懸停可看三條觸發線的具體數值、逐輪 token、上次請求用量與最近一次壓縮。
- **`!!ask context --all`** — 按模型彙總全服用量，零用量的模型不列出；懸停顯示**自插件載入以來**的累計消耗與快取命中率（0.1% 精度）。累計值不會因壓縮而減少。
- **`!!ask compact`** — 忽略觸發線，立即壓縮較早的歷史；延後到下次提問的預檢執行，指令本身不阻塞。

### 🔧 修復

- **`!!ask stop it.` 不再被丟棄** — 以前 `stop` 是獨立指令節點，帶多餘文字會被 MCDR 判為未知參數並**整條不執行**；`!!ask switch it.` 則把 `it.` 當模型名。現在 `!!ask` 由指令分派器解析，只有**恰好是那個詞**才當子指令，任何句子都會落到 AI。順帶修好 `!!ask -n`（缺內容）與 `!!ask contextual` 被前綴吞掉的問題。
- **兩次 `!!gamesai reload` 並行會把假人功能關掉** — 後者的連接埠探測把前者未結束的 Node 當成外來程式，進而把 `mineflayer_bot.enabled` 寫成 `false`。現在重載單飛（重入直接拒絕），連接埠探測會先等待停機完成。
- **`mineflayer_bot.enabled` 被誤關閉** — 寫 `config.json` 前先確保目錄存在；`stop_mineflayer_bot` 補上缺失的 `@register_bot_tool()`。

### 🧹 卸載與停機不再被假人拖住

- Node 停機從「逐級升級、最多串行等 21 秒」改為一次終止 + 有限等待，**實測 5 毫秒**；
- 卸載把停機搬到獨立背景執行緒，`on_unload` 只同步等 1.5 秒；該執行緒只用純 Python 物件，不碰 MCDR 狀態；
- 首次連線退避（新設定項 `first_connect_interval`，預設 0.5 秒），不再因為 Node 還在啟動就白等 10 秒。

### 🧵 執行緒可觀測

- 新增 **`!!gamesai debug thread`**：列出插件持有的執行緒（id、名稱、daemon、`native=`）；
- 全部執行緒統一命名 `games_ai@...`；卸載後殘留的舊控制器執行緒會在下次載入時被中止，而不是與新實例並存。

### 📚 文件重寫與新增

- 原「工具與 Skills」一頁**拆分為獨立的[工具](docs/zh_tw/tools.md)與[技能](docs/zh_tw/skills.md)**，並按當前實作重寫：補齊**權限**與 **Bot 可見性**兩欄、修正與程式碼不符的參數說明（如 `delegate_to_bot` 的 `username`、`bot_call_action` 的可選參數）、說明 `tools.py` 中無裝飾器的公開函式會被拒絕載入；
- 新增**[範例](docs/zh_tw/example.md)**：一台真實伺服器從設定、六個技能、44 個自訂工具到一輪實操的完整實例，含踩坑表與取捨分析；
- 技術文件現為**九個**頁面，隨插件一起打包。

### 升級提示

- 版本號由 `0.7.2-SNAPSHOT-4` 定為 **`0.7.2`**；舊設定裡的歷史長度鍵（如 `max_history`）會被忽略，無需改動。
- 新增可選設定 `mineflayer_bot.websocket.first_connect_interval`（預設 0.5），不填也會按此預設值運作。

完整說明見 [`docs/zh_tw/changelog.md`](docs/zh_tw/changelog.md)。

releases.description:
## GamesAI v0.7.1

本次更新围绕「上下文」做了一次系统性重构：不再有固定历史条数，模型窗口自动解析、按真实用量触发压缩；切换模型改为**摘要转接**；新增 **`!!ask stop`** 立即中止对话；全部内置工具文本英文化。

### 🧮 上下文自动管理（不再需要 `max_history`）
- **窗口自动解析**：单模型 `context_window` 覆盖 → 远程窗口表 → 版本内置表 → 保守默认值 `32768`；
- **触发条件**（每次请求前后都检查）：上下文达到窗口 **80%**，或单次请求达到 **20%**（捕捉超大工具结果这类突发）；
- **压缩方式**：最近 **10 轮**始终原样保留，更早的轮次合并为一条中性事实摘要（由当前模型生成、不带工具）；仍不足时先截断超长消息、再丢弃最旧轮次，保证请求一定装得下；
- **用量校准**：以服务商返回的 `usage` 为准，按 `base_url|model` 校准本地估算，几轮内收敛；
- `max_history` 配置**已移除**（旧配置文件仍可用，该键被忽略）。

### 📊 远程窗口表 + 内置兜底表
- 仓库维护 [`data/context_windows.json`](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/blob/main/data/context_windows.json)（**249 条**，覆盖 19 家厂商与各托管平台，核验日期 2026-09-11，来源见 `data/context_windows.sources.md`）；
- 启动时随 24 小时更新检查一起拉取，缓存在 `config/games_ai/cache/context_windows.json`（24h TTL）；**`!!gamesai check` 会无视 TTL 强制刷新**；离线时静默回退到内置表；
- 内置表移入生成式模块 `games_ai/context_table_data.py`（每条一行，维护脚本 `tools/build_context_table.py` 可一键重生成并校验）。

### 🔀 `!!ask switch` 改为摘要转接（社区投票方案 B1）
- 切换时**立即清空原历史**并保存快照，**不发任何 API 请求**，指令瞬间返回；
- 在你**下次提问前**（与自动上下文压缩同一时机）由**旧模型**把快照压缩成一段中性事实摘要，作为新会话的第一条 system 消息注入，并提示新模型保持自己的风格；
- 摘要失败时本轮仍正常回答，只是新对话不带旧上下文，并会告知你；
- 切换到当前模型不做任何改动；无历史时不产生额外请求；连续切换只总结一次。

### 🛑 新增 `!!ask stop`
- 一次停止你名下所有进行中的内容：运行中的对话轮（含工具调用）、`!!ask -n` 提问、以及你委派给自治 Bot 的任务；
- **未完成的一步会被删除**：末尾是工具调用组则整组删除（不留孤立 tool 消息），否则删除该轮追加的全部消息（含 `-f` 合并进来的），停在最后一条已完成的回答之前；
- 进行中的 HTTP 请求无法真正中断，因此轮次会在下一个检查点停止（最多延迟一次请求）；停止后可以立刻继续提问；
- 无需任何权限，只作用于你自己的对话。

### 🪶 `!!ask -n` 无状态路径
- 单次提问不再创建（然后丢弃）一个完整的对话对象：新类 `NonHistoryChatParam` 不保留历史、队列与上下文记账，也不产生摘要请求；
- 与常规路径**回答完全一致**（相同的 system 消息、按权限过滤的工具、同轮工具回环、错误上报格式）；
- 新增单轮超窗保险（超过窗口 80% 时截断最新消息）；HTTP 客户端按 `base_url` + API Key 复用，连续提问不再重复 TLS 握手。

### 🧰 工具
- **全部 26 个内置工具的文本英文化**：schema（名称/说明/参数）与**返回值**（执行结果、错误、权限提示）均为英文，函数调用提示词不再中英混用；发给玩家的进度提示仍保持本地化；
- **`modify_skills` / `modify_custom_tools` 改为编辑式**：传入 `old_string`（Python 正则）与 `new_string`（支持 `\1`、`\g<name>`），替换所有匹配而不是覆写整个文件；正则无法编译或匹配不到时退回字面替换；完全匹配不到则不写盘并明确报错；`modify_skills` 的 `summary` 变为可选；
- `custom_tools_management` 技能新增**强制 Step 0**：AI 必须先向你确认需求、参数、权限等级与期望返回值，才能开始写代码。

### 🔧 其他改进与修复
- 未映射的 HTTP 错误码改用翻译键 `games_ai.error_code_map.error_unknown`，跟随玩家语言；
- 窗口表刷新与启动/24h 更新检查合并为同一条链路（少一个线程，且并发不再重复下载）；
- `!!ask switch` 的确认文案按"下一次提问前压缩"重写，并修掉了模型名后悬挂标点的问题；
- 三语 README 全面更新：请求链路流程图、无历史路径、摘要转接、停止对话等章节。

### ⚠️ 升级提示
- `max_history` 被忽略，可保留在旧配置里；如需限制上下文规模，请用 `all_ai.<id>.context_window`；
- 0.7.0 的"切换模型保留全部历史"已改为摘要转接；`!!ask -m/--model` 仍为移除状态，请用 `!!ask switch`；
- 新文件 `data/`、`games_ai/context_table.py`、`games_ai/context_table_data.py`、`tools/` 需随插件一起分发。

---

- `@register_tool` 新增 `perm` 参数（可填固定等级，也可动态跟随插件的 `permission` 设置）。

Fixed a critical bug where using blocking tools (such as setting timers) could cause persistent HTTP 400 errors and conversation history corruption. When a tool blocked the request thread, incomplete tool call records leaked into shared conversation history, causing all subsequent requests to fail until the history was manually cleared. Now each request safely manages its own conversation state, and concurrent requests no longer overwrite each other.

# GamesAI for MCDReforged English | [简体中文](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main//README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main//README.zh-TW.md) [Report an Issue](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/issues/new) | [Share an Idea](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/discussions/new/choose) | [Join QQ Group](https://qm.qq.com/q/jDQQaUPNmw) [Go to Fabric Version](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/GamesAI)
> [!NOTE] > **GamesAI Plugin/Mod QQ Group: 849544707** — Join us to discuss issues, share feedback, and exchange prompt, skills, tools configurations! > [!NOTE] > Welcome to version 0.7.3! This release reworks the **message layout of a request**: there is only one system message now (the model's prompt + the skills list), the current time travels as a `user` message in front of the question and is re-injected periodically, the public data travels as an `assistant` message, and adjacent `user` messages are merged into one before sending — so models that accept a single leading system message only (Qwen3.5 and friends) work again, and the provider's prefix cache keeps hitting in long conversations. See [What's New](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/changelog.md#whats-new) for details.
Table of Contents (click to expand) - [GamesAI for MCDReforged](#gamesai-for-mcdreforged) - [Installation](#installation) - [Usage](#usage) - [Technical Documentation](#technical-documentation) - [The Role of AI in This Project](#the-role-of-ai-in-this-project) - [Acknowledgements \& Disclaimer](#acknowledgements--disclaimer) - [Sponsorship \& Contributors](#sponsorship--contributors) - [License](#license)
## Installation Run the following command in the MCDR console to install the plugin: `!!MCDR plugin install games_ai` --- Alternatively, get it from the [MCDR Plugin Repository](https://mcdreforged.com/plugin/games_ai) and place it in your plugin directory. If you choose to install manually, install the Python packages `openai`, `requests`, and `websockets` first: ```bash pip install openai requests websockets ``` ## Usage Type `!!gamesai` anywhere to display all available features of this plugin. | Command | Description | | ------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `!!gamesai clear` | Clear your own chat history. Chat history is unrelated to the public database. | | `!!gamesai clearall` | Clear all players' chat history. Chat history is unrelated to the public database. | | `!!gamesai reload` | Reload the plugin configuration file. See [Hot Reload](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/hot-reload.md#hot-reload) for details. | | `!!gamesai check` | Check for plugin updates and force-refresh the context-window table. | | `!!gamesai speedtest [model]` | Test API server connection latency. If no model is specified, all models are tested. | | `!!gamesai config get ` | Read a configuration value. | | `!!gamesai config set ` | Update a configuration value (auto type-adapts; automatically triggers [Hot Reload](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/hot-reload.md#hot-reload)). | --- You can also use `!!ask` directly to ask the AI questions, chat, or ask it to do things for you. | Command | Description | | ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `!!ask ` | Ask the AI a question, chat, or ask it to do something. `` is what you want the AI to do or the question you want to ask. | | `!!ask -n ` | Ask the AI without using conversation history (current conversation is still saved). | | `!!ask -f ` | Force-ask without waiting: the request is merged into the round that is currently running (alias: `-forced`). See [AI Request Pipeline & Chat Mechanism](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#ai-request-pipeline--chat-mechanism). | | `!!ask switch ` | Switch the AI model for your current conversation (`` is the AI_ID or nickname). The history is cleared and the old model summarizes it right before your next request, handing the summary to the new model. See [Summary Hand-off on Model Switch](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#summary-hand-off-on-model-switch). | | `!!ask stop` | Immediately stop everything you have in flight: your running round (tool calls included), a running `!!ask -n` request and a task you delegated to the bot. The interrupted step is deleted from the history and queued `!!ask -f` messages are discarded. See [Stopping a running round](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#stopping-a-running-round). | | `!!ask context [player]` | Show the context usage: model and window source, how much of the window is used, how many tokens are left before compression, the per-round sizes and the cache-hit rate. Without a player name it shows your own. See [Context Inspection](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#context-inspection). | | `!!ask context --all` | Sum the context usage of every player on the server, grouped by model (models with zero usage are not listed); hover for the totals since the plugin was loaded. See [Context Inspection](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#context-inspection). | | `!!ask compact` | Compress the older history right now, ignoring the compression triggers. It is performed by the preflight of your next question, so the command itself never blocks. See [Context Inspection](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md#context-inspection). | --- Type `!!data` for information about database commands. > [!TIP] > The database is automatically created when upgrading to version 0.3.0 or above. | Command | Description | | ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | `!!data write ` | Add a data entry to the public database. `` must not contain spaces; `` can be any string. | | `!!data add ` | Append `` to an existing key in the public database. Creates a new key if it does not exist. | | `!!data del ` | Delete a data entry from the public database, regardless of whether the key exists. | | `!!data read ` | Read the value associated with a key from the public database. | | `!!data list` | Read all entries in the public database. | | `!!data list keys` | Read all keys in the public database. | --- ## Technical Documentation The technical details live in [`docs/en_us/`](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/) — how a request is built and kept inside the window, what every configuration key does, how tools and skills work, how the bot is driven, and what to do when something fails. | Document | Contents | | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | [AI Request Pipeline](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/ai-request-pipeline.md) | Request chain, the stateless `!!ask -n`, the `!!ask switch` hand-off, `!!ask stop`, automatic context management, per-user state | | [Configuration](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/configuration.md) | Every key of `config.json`: `prefix`, `permission`, `all_ai` (incl. `context_window`), `default_ai`, `mineflayer_bot` | | [Tools](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/tools.md) | The 26 built-in tools, writing your own in `tools.py`, registering tools from your own plugin, permissions and visibility | | [Skills](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/skills.md) | What skills are for, the built-in ones, `skills.json`, letting the AI write them, registering them from your own plugin | | [Example](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/example.md) | A real server configuration end to end: config, six skills, 44 custom tools, a walkthrough round and the pitfalls | | [Mineflayer Bot](https://github.com/PengZixuan30/Games_AI/tree/main/docs/en_us/mineflayer-bot.md) |
